production.direction_en: Pippa sings the lost names back to frightened villagers while a bell charm trembles at her wrist.
production.music_direction_en: pre: Pippa's song is diegetic: lute and voice only (record with her VO) | post: bgm_warmth

commands.speaker: pippa_bell
commands.text: I am carrying the names to the refuge. Someone has to keep them safe.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: I will go with Mahmut and Fadyme. The village has its gate back.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: Then the road has room for one more.

commands.speaker: narration
commands.text: Jori joins permanently as a story recruit.
